title: Bower Security Telemetry Bridge
descriptionMarkdown:
The [Bower](https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower) data connector ingests validated, redacted semantic security events from self-hosted Bower collectors into the `BowerSecurity_CL` custom table via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API (`Custom-BowerSecurity` DCR) or the Azure Monitor Agent Linux syslog path (`ama-syslog`).

All regulated Australian identifiers (TFN, Medicare, IHI, ABN/ACN), payment cards and credentials are redacted by Bower's deterministic Privacy & Secret Protection Engine before events leave the host.

sampleQueries.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| summarize Events = count() by EventCategory, EventType
| order by Events desc

BowerSecurity_CL
| where EventType == "collector_health"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Attributes) by CollectorId
| project CollectorId, TimeGenerated, Status = tostring(Attributes.status), Delivery = tostring(Attributes.delivery.status)

sampleQueries.description: Privacy and Secret Protection Engine alerts (metadata only)
sampleQueries.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where EventType == "sensitive_data_detected"
| project BowerEventTime, ApplicationName, EventSeverity, CollectorId, PrivacyDetected
| take 50

dataTypes.name: BowerSecurity_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
BowerSecurity_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
BowerSecurity_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions on the Log Analytics workspace.
Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the Bower Data Collection Rule for each collector identity.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Provision the BowerSecurity_CL table, DCE and DCR
instructionSteps.description: Deploy `deploy/bicep/main.bicep` (or the one-click template `deploy/sentinel/azuredeploy.json`) into the resource group that holds your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. Grant the collector's managed identity or service principal the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role on the Data Collection Rule only.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure the Bower collector output
instructionSteps.description: Set `BOWER_OUTPUT=azure-logs-ingestion`, `BOWER_DCE_ENDPOINT`, `BOWER_DCR_ID`, `BOWER_STREAM_NAME=Custom-BowerSecurity` and `BOWER_AZURE_CREDENTIAL=managed-identity` (or use `BOWER_OUTPUT=ama-syslog` with `deploy/bicep/ama-syslog-dcr.bicep` on Linux hosts running Azure Monitor Agent).

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify ingestion with destination-query evidence
instructionSteps.description: Run `bower evidence run --collector-url <url> --workspace-id <workspace-id> --signing-key <key>` or query `BowerSecurityEvents | take 10` in Logs before enabling scheduled analytics rules.
